csvQuotingValidation: Delimiter/quote-aware CSV escaping verified with LibreOffice 24.8.7.2. Legacy Text filter aliases use equivalent explicit native delimiter, quote, UTF-8 and quote-all=false options. Existing CR/CRLF cell contents remain unchanged; native exports normalize these to LF. rich-inheritance, rich-nested-link and legacy-generic use equivalent plain-cell inputs to isolate quoting from their existing import differences.
referenceListOrderValidation: LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 verifies changed calculation caches. Sheet-reference spelling is checked against native exports and native reimports of old/new XLSX. Existing ODS name-scope/base, reversed-range and SHEET/SHEETS spelling differences remain; unrelated XML structure and package parts are unchanged.
exportMetadataValidation: LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 controls validate exporter identity, disabled default iteration, omitted synthetic names and lowercase unknown Gnumeric functions. Other archive parts and cell data match the prior snapshot, apart from 75 independently verified unknown-function controls in soffice-ods-references.json.
archiveMetadata: Content-focused cases include a root manifest entry matching their ODS/SXC MIME; deliberately invalid archives retain their original bytes.
nativeExportValidation: LibreOffice 24.8.7.2: explicit Writer Text filter refuses Calc export; default spreadsheet export refuses Writer input. Source parts retained unchanged.
